name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for generating employment opportunities through micro-enterprises.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Financial, technical and business support for micro food processing enterprises.
eligibility: Existing micro food processing units, FPOs, SHGs

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Loans up to 10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
